name: Lyo.Rfid.Tonie
tagline: Tonie SLIX-L content path, privacy XOR, and custom-tag frames.
description: ICODE SLIX-L helpers for a Toniebox tag you program yourself. `TonieContentPath.FromUid` turns an 8-byte UID that starts with `E0 04 03` into the SD-card directory and file name (each half reversed). `SlixPrivacy.XorPassword` applies the NXP formula `Password XOR {Random, Random}` to the two-byte GET RANDOM NUMBER result. Custom tags use the datasheet factory privacy password `0F0F0F0F` (`ToniePrivacy.NxpDefault`). `TonieTagSession` sends GET RANDOM, SET PASSWORD, block read/write, and ENABLE PRIVACY through `Lyo.Rfid.IIso15693Transceiver`. A Type 2 NFC reader cannot carry those frames.
features: **Content path.** File name is the first four UID bytes reversed. Directory name is the last four reversed. `E004035012345678` is file `500304E0` and directory `78563412`.
**Privacy XOR.** A 4-byte password and a 2-byte random become the session password. `0F0F0F0F` with random `1234` is `1D3B1D3B`.
**Prepare.** `PrepareCustomTagAsync` writes 32 bytes (zeros when omitted) and enables privacy so the box will accept the tag.
